theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners exhibit the strongest trend-health combination among scorable themes: hurst_tag 'trend', higher durability (0.79), full breadth (1.0), and no crowding flag. The absolute-trend gate, the only validated drawdown-control edge, is currently satisfied; maintaining exposure while the trend is intact aligns with the detector's documented risk reduction.
